[[Espérance de Tunis|EST]] 4–0 [[US Monastir (football)|USM]] | biggest away win = [[Stade Tunisien]] 0–4 [[Espérance de Tunis|ES Tunis]] | highest scoring = [[Olympique Béja|OB]] 5–2 [[Stade Gabésien|SG]] | matches = 182 | total goals = 374 | prevseason = [[2006–07 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2006–07]] | nextseason = [[2008–09 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2008–09]] }} The '''2007–08 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1''' was the 53rd season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Tunisia]]. It saw [[Club Africain]] crowned as champions. [[Stade Gabésien]] and [[Espérance Sportive de Zarzis]] were relegated to [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|Ligue Professionnelle 2]]. It was played in a traditional [[Sports league|league]] format, with 14 teams playing 26 rounds, two matches against every opposing team. [[Club Sportif Sfaxien]] had two points deducted from their end of season total due to walking off field before completion of their round 15 game against [[Espérance Sportive de Tunis]].{{cite web|title=CSS points deduction |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tun08.html |access-date=9 October 2010 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100330084014/http://www.rsssf.com/tablest/tun08.html |archive-date=30 March 2010 }} ==Club directory and team locations== {{Location map+ |Tunisia |width=300 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2007–08 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 |places= {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=36.8 |long=10.183333 |label=Tunis teams:
